item.summary: ICU Medical became aware of an increased likelihood of leakage in specific Lots of L-70 HOTLINE Fluid Warming Sets due to potentially inadequate solvent application at the tubing to return connector bond. Product details: Hotline Fluid Warming Set, single use device, is designed to warm blood and intravenous fluids and deliver them to the patient's intravenous access site at normothermic temperatures under gravity flow conditions, List Number L-70
